verdicts.evidence: lines 399-410 Find rooms submits and calls findRooms; 539-588 Book room calls createBooking; 636-644 Book another room resets and shows the form; 506-509 Try again reruns the search; 511 Change the time focuses the start field. No button lacks a handler.

lines 372-376, 424-444: room rows are built only from api.findRooms results; 596-604 confirmation rows come from the createBooking result. No hardcoded records, counts or placeholder text; empty result shows a message (511).

line 496 results summary shows date, time span and people above the rooms; line 460 book-summary shows room, when and people directly above Book room; the criteria form stays visible on the same page; 596-604 confirmation lists every answer.

lines 339-345 saveDraft writes all fields, room and searched flag to sessionStorage on every input/change (416, 526, 530); 651-667 restores them on reload and reruns the search; failed booking (571-586) leaves fields untouched. Single page, no Back step.

line 185 catering unchecked by default; 147 duration 1 hour; 292-299 default start is the next future half hour; 377 preselects the smallest fitting room, which the summary at 460 names before Book room. Enter in the criteria form only searches. No default loses data or adds cost.
lines 127-200: criteria, room choice, details and Book room are all in one view with no dialog or extra screen; the done view (202-206) is only the result.

lines 130-198, 202-206: criteria fields, free rooms list, title, catering, note, Book room and a confirmation list all map to brief tasks. The Ends hint (154) and booking reference (603) support when/confirm. No extra panels, stats or feeds.
line 483 removes btn-primary from Find rooms whenever rooms are shown, so Book room (196) is the only primary then; Try again and Change the time use plain .btn (469); done view has one button (205).
No action deletes, overwrites or is irreversible. Book another room (636-644) runs only after the booking is saved and discards nothing unsaved.

lines 482, 536: buttons get aria-disabled only while their own request is in flight (the stated exception), with busy labels 481, 535. No other control is disabled; catering on a room without it is explained in text under the checkbox (447-454, 459).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script (lines 124-207, 247-669).
All visible strings (lines 128-196, 354-361, 451-453, 493, 500, 506, 511, 583, 593-603) concern booking a room. Nothing mentions implementation, mock data, the request or unfinished features.

Notices: stale-results message (493) sits in the results area and prompts Find rooms again; catering conflict (451-453) sits under the catering checkbox and names the choice; Ends hint (336) under Duration informs the duration choice. No standing callouts or disclaimers.

No text narrates the layout. The only how-to sentences are state messages at the point of action: line 493 'Find rooms again to see what is free' after criteria change, and catering recovery text at the checkbox (451-453). Headings and labels carry the rest.

Labels have no restating helper text (132-193). 'Ends ...' hint (336) adds a derived value. Results summary (496) gives criteria, not a reworded 'Free rooms'. book-summary (460) repeats when/people further down but adds the room at the commit point; judged not a restatement of a neighbour.

Headings 'Book a meeting room' (128), 'Free rooms' (166), 'Meeting details' (177), '<room> is booked' (593). No greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks in text; the '!' at line 51 is a CSS error icon.
Button labels: 'Find rooms' (162, 481), 'Book room' (196, 535), 'Book another room' (205), 'Try again' (506), 'Change the time' (511). All start with a specific verb; no OK/Submit/Done.

Feature keys are mapped to user words (261, 440) and statuses read 'Requested'/'Not requested' (601). But line 603 shows the raw server id (e.g. 'bk_48213') as 'Booking reference'. Two readings disagreed on whether that is a user-facing reference or a leaked system ID.

line 506 'Could not check which rooms are free.' with Try again; 583 'Could not book the room, so nothing is booked yet. Try again.'; 354-361, 388, 546, 578 field messages name the problem and fix. err.message and codes are never displayed (383-395, 571-586).
Error strings at lines 354-361, 388, 451-453, 506, 546, 578, 583 contain no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', all caps or exclamation marks in text, and describe the problem rather than blaming the user.
lines 510-511: zero rooms shows 'No room that size is free at that time.' with a 'Change the time' button that focuses the start time field; the booking form is hidden (490).

lines 505-511: load failure shows 'Could not check which rooms are free.' + Try again; no match shows 'No room that size is free at that time.' + Change the time; stale criteria shows its own message (493). Each cause has its own text and action.

Search failure: 393-395 and 505-509 show the message with Try again in the results area, criteria kept. Booking failure: 572, 583-585 re-enable the button, show a persistent message above it, and leave title, catering, note and room untouched.

lines 367-368, 481, 498-503: on search the button reads 'Finding rooms...' and a text line plus skeleton rows appear immediately; 533-536, 558 Book room reads 'Booking...'. Calls take at most about 1.5s (213), so no progress or cancel is needed.

lines 498-504 loading branch renders only the checking text and skeletons; the empty message is reached only when status is 'ok' with zero rooms (510); the booking form is hidden while loading (479, 490). No counts are shown.

overflow-wrap: anywhere on h1, room name, summary and dd (28, 94, 111, 116); grid tracks use minmax(0, ...) (87, 98, 114); buttons wrap (70). Missing values get text: 'No equipment' (441), note 'None' (602). No undefined/null paths found; list simply grows with many rooms.

lines 339-345 and 416, 526, 530: every edit is written to sessionStorage; 651-667 restore date, time, duration, people, title, catering, note and chosen room on return or reload, so unsaved edits are kept.

Date and time use native inputs (134, 139) with min set to today (647) and a valid future default (292-299, 620-622); the only free-typed constrained field is labelled 'Number of people' with inputmode numeric (157-158). No hidden length or pattern rule beyond what the labels state.

line 191 'Note for reception (optional)' marks the one optional text field in words; date, start, people and title carry required (134, 139, 158, 180); note has none (192); catering is an opt-in checkbox (185) and duration always has a value.
Validation runs only in submit handlers (403, 546-550). Input handlers only clear errors (413, 529). The catering conflict appears on change of the checkbox or room (519-525), not during typing.

Each field has its own error paragraph directly beneath it (135, 140, 159, 181, 188) filled by setError (322-329); marked by a 2px border (47), bold text and a '!' icon (49-54). The non-field booking error sits above the Book button (195).
Client rejections (404-408, 551-555) and server rejections (385-392, 571-586) only set messages and focus; no field is cleared. resetForm runs only on load and after Book another room (636-648).
lines 405, 552, 389, 575, 580 focus the first invalid field; setError sets aria-invalid (325); every input has a static aria-describedby pointing at its error paragraph (134, 139, 158, 180, 185).

Neither submit button is ever disabled before completion; aria-disabled is set only during the request (482, 536). Submitting incomplete input shows per-field messages and focuses the first (403-408, 546-555).

line 541 'if (booking) return' with flag set at 558 and label 'Booking...' (535); line 402 ignores a repeat search with the same criteria while loading, and searchSeq (366, 373) discards superseded responses.

runSearch calls render() synchronously before awaiting (367-368), changing the button label and showing skeletons; setBooking(true) runs before the await (558); radios and checkbox are native; Book another room switches view at once (640-641).
Success replaces the form with '<room> is booked' and the booking details (591-617); search results render in place (513-514); every failure path sets a visible message (388, 506, 574, 578, 583).
The only success message is the confirmation view itself (593-611), which is the sole place the saved booking is visible. No toast or banner duplicates a result already on screen.

Errors are rendered in place with no timers: field errors persist until edited (413, 529), the search error stays in the results area until retried or criteria change (505-509), the booking error stays until the next attempt (557, 583-584). No auto-dismissing toasts.
No action removes, archives, moves or changes an existing item; the flow only creates a booking and no cancel or delete control exists.

No action permanently deletes or overwrites data. Book room (539-588) creates a booking, with the room, time and people named in the summary directly above it (460); judged not an irreversible action under this rule.
No confirmation dialogs: no confirm(), dialog element or modal markup in the file.
No optimistic updates: the confirmation view is shown only after createBooking resolves (562-570) and rooms only after findRooms resolves (372-378).
No modal dialogs in markup or script (lines 124-207, 247-669).
No modal dialogs in markup or script (lines 124-207, 247-669).

lines 128-163: the page opens on the h1 and the criteria form with the primary Find rooms button; results and meeting details follow in task order (165-198). Nothing decorative precedes or outweighs them.
lines 127-131: heading 'Book a meeting room' is followed directly by the criteria form. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.
No stat cards, summary metrics or charts. The only numbers are room attributes and the booking details.

The room list is the answer to mandatory search criteria, not a filterable list with an unfiltered state; there are no filter, sort or column controls to clear. The criteria in force are shown as text above the results (496) and stale results are replaced (492-494).

All controls are native: date, time, select, text inputs, radios inside labels (425-429), checkbox, textarea and buttons (132-205), inside forms that submit on Enter. No click-only custom widgets; focus styles at line 46; no focus trap.
Errors carry text plus a '!' icon and a thicker border (47-54), not colour alone; the selected room is shown by the checked native radio as well as border and tint (92-93). No colour-only status.

line 125 a role=status aria-live=polite region exists on load; announce() (287-290) fills it for loading (370), result counts (380-382), failures (395, 585), catering conflicts (524) and success (615). Errors use the polite region rather than role=alert, but are announced.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; the only select is native (144) and the results section appears as a search result, not via a toggle.

viewport meta (5); main padding 16px (27); criteria stack in a column at <=480px (62-65); room rows use a two-column grid below 620px (86-96); confirmation list becomes one column (117-120); inputs max-width 100% and 44px high (40-44); buttons wrap (70). No dialogs.
